description: Implementation of PermissionReadPlatformService for retrieving permission data from the database, including methods for all permissions, maker-checker permissions, and role-specific permissions, with internal data mapping logic.

classes.name: PermissionReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class for reading permission data, implementing PermissionReadPlatformService interface.

classes.name: PermissionUsageDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper class for mapping SQL result set rows to PermissionData objects, with methods to generate specific permission schema queries.

methods.name: retrieveAllPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves all non-CHECKER permissions from the database.

methods.name: retrieveAllMakerCheckerablePermissions
methods.description: Retrieves all 'Maker-Checkerable' permissions, excluding special, read, and checker permissions.

methods.name: retrieveAllRolePermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with a specific role ID.
